The '''Foraging Sack''' is a [[Sack]] unlocked in the {{LI|Birch Log}} collection at {{coll|Birch Log 2}}, {{coll|Birch Log 5}}, {{coll|Birch Log 7}}, {{coll|Birch Log 8}}, and {{Coll|Birch Log 9}} with increasing capacity. The Small Foraging Sack can hold {{Green|2,240}} of each item, the Medium Foraging Sack can hold {{Green|6,720}} of each item, and the Large Foraging Sack can hold {{Green|20,160}} of each item. Beginner Sack holds {{Green|640}} items, but only includes early game resources. The Large Enchanted Foraging Sack holds {{Green|20,160}} of enchanted items.

== Obtaining ==
=== Merchant ===
The Beginner Foraging Sack can be bought for {{c|250}} at {{NPCSprite|Lumber Merchant}} in the [[Hub]] near the {{Zone|Foraging Camp}}.
